item.name: 📋 Accounts
item.description:
Chart of accounts management.

**Hierarchy rules**
- Root accounts: supply `type` + `normalBalance`.
- Child accounts: `normalBalance` is always inherited from the parent (omit or match); `type` must match parent, except `CASH` is allowed under `ASSET`.
- `normalBalance` is immutable after creation.
- Only leaf accounts (no children) may receive journal lines.

**See also:** folder **🔒 Validation — server rules (accounting)** for A2, N2, opening-balance, and journal DTO rules.

item.name: List accounts (paginated)
item.description:
Returns paginated accounts. Pagination metadata is in response headers:
- `X-Total-Count`: total matching records
- `Current-Page`: current page number
- `Has-Next-Page`: true/false

item.description: Pass `parentAccountId=null` (or the string 'null') to list only top-level root accounts that have no parent.

query.description: Pass 'null' (string) or empty to get root accounts only

item.name: Get account — 404 (not found)
item.description: ❌ Expected: **404 Not Found** when the account id does not exist.

item.name: ✅ Create root account
item.description:
Root account: must supply `type` and `normalBalance`. `code` is auto-generated.

Saves the new account id into `{{newAccountId}}` for use in subsequent requests.

item.name: ✅ Create child account (inherits parent)
item.description: Child of `الاصول المتداوله` (id=17, type=ASSET). `normalBalance` is NOT sent — it is inherited automatically from the parent. `type=CASH` is allowed under an ASSET parent.

item.name: ✅ Create child account (omit type → inherited)
item.description: When `type` is omitted, it defaults to the parent's type. Parent id=4 is `الإيرادات` (REVENUE), so this child will also be REVENUE.

item.name: ✅ Create account with opening balance (locked on create)
item.description:
Supplying `openingBalance` at create time immediately locks it (`openingBalanceLocked=true`). It cannot be changed via the PUT `/opening-balance` endpoint later.

**Rule N2:** If this returns **400** with message about **posted transactions** in the branch, the parent (`id=17` here) subtree already has POSTED activity — create with `openingBalance: 0` or use another parent. See folder **🔒 Validation — server rules (accounting)**.

item.name: ❌ Root account — missing type → 400
item.description:
❌ Expected: **400 Bad Request**.

Rule: Root accounts (no `parentAccountId`) **must** supply both `type` and `normalBalance`. Missing `type` causes a validation failure.

item.name: ❌ Child account — wrong type under parent → 400
item.description:
❌ Expected: **400 Bad Request**.

Rule: Child type must match parent type (or be CASH under ASSET). Parent id=17 is ASSET; `LIABILITY` is not allowed here.

item.name: ❌ Child account — normalBalance conflicts parent → 400
item.description:
❌ Expected: **400 Bad Request**.

Rule: `normalBalance` is always inherited from the parent. Sending a value that **conflicts** with the parent's `normalBalance` is rejected. Parent id=17 (ASSET) uses DEBIT; sending CREDIT triggers the error.

item.name: ✅ Set opening balance (once)
item.description: Sets the stored opening balance for a **non-system** account that has never had it set before. After this call, `openingBalanceLocked` becomes `true`.

item.name: ❌ Set opening balance — system account → 403
item.description:
❌ Expected: **403 Forbidden**.

Rule: System chart accounts (seeded, `isSystem=true`) have their opening balances defined at seed time and **cannot** be overridden via the API.

item.name: ❌ Set opening balance — system account → 403
item.description:
❌ Expected: **403 Forbidden**.

Rule: System chart accounts (seeded, `isSystem=true`) have their opening balances defined at seed time and **cannot** be overridden via the API.

item.name: ✅ Update account (rename)
item.description: Partial update — only the fields sent are changed. `normalBalance` is **not** accepted in the update body (immutable).

item.name: ❌ Update account — self as parent → 400
item.description:
❌ Expected: **400 Bad Request**.

Rule: An account cannot reference itself as its own parent.

item.name: ❌ Update account — circular reference → 400
item.description:
❌ Expected: **400 Bad Request**.

Rule: Moving account id=1 (الأصول root) under id=6 (الاصول الغير متداوله, which is already a descendant of id=1) would create a circular reference. The API detects this and rejects the move.

item.name: ❌ Update system account → 403
item.description:
❌ Expected: **403 Forbidden**.

Rule: System accounts (`isSystem=true`) are part of the seeded chart of accounts and are read-only via the API.

item.name: ✅ Delete account
item.description: Deletes a user-created, non-system account that has no children and no transaction lines.

item.name: ❌ Delete account — has children → 400
item.description:
❌ Expected: **400 Bad Request**.

Rule: Cannot delete an account that has child accounts. Remove or reassign children first.

(Also a system account → would be 403, but the children check fires first in real cases.)

item.name: ❌ Delete account — has transaction lines → 400
item.description:
❌ Expected: **400 Bad Request** (or **403** for system accounts).

Rule: Cannot delete an account that has journal lines attached to it.

item.name: ❌ Delete system account → 403
item.description:
❌ Expected: **403 Forbidden**.

Rule: System accounts (isSystem=true) cannot be deleted via the API.

item.name: ❌ Set opening balance — already locked → 400
item.description:
❌ Expected: **400 Bad Request**.

Rule: Opening balance can only be set **once**. After the first call, `openingBalanceLocked=true` and any further attempt is rejected.

item.name: 🔒 Validation — server rules (accounting)
item.description:
Explicit **server-side** rules aligned with the accounting module implementation.

| Tag | Rule |
|-----|------|
| **A2** | Root `type` ↔ `normalBalance` pairing |
| **N2** | Non-zero child `openingBalance` blocked when branch has **POSTED** lines |
| **O1–O3** | Opening balance only on leaf; not when lines exist; lock after activity |
| **V1** | PUT OB rejected for parents |
| **T2** | Line `amount` ≥ 0.01 |

Set collection variables: `validationParentWithPosted`, `validationParentNonLeaf`, `leafAccountWithJournalLines`, `accountWithNonZeroOpening`, `validationDebitAccountId`, `validationCreditAccountId` for your database.

item.name: ❌ Root — A2 type vs normalBalance mismatch → 400
item.description:
❌ Expected: **400 Bad Request**.

**Rule A2:** `ASSET` / `EXPENSE` / `CASH` → `DEBIT`; `LIABILITY` / `EQUITY` / `REVENUE` → `CREDIT`.

Response message pattern: `For account type "EQUITY", normalBalance must be CREDIT.`

item.name: ❌ Root — A2 ASSET with CREDIT → 400
item.description:
❌ Expected: **400 Bad Request**.

**Rule A2:** Message pattern: `For account type "ASSET", normalBalance must be DEBIT.`

item.name: ❌ Child — N2 non-zero OB under branch with posted tx → 400
item.description:
❌ Expected: **400 Bad Request** when the parent branch already has **POSTED** journal activity (parent + subtree).

**Rule N2:** Message: `A non-zero opening balance is not allowed under this account because the branch already has posted transactions...`

Collection variable `validationParentWithPosted` defaults to **17** (current assets). If your DB has no posted lines under that branch, you may get **201** — pick another `parentAccountId` that has posted activity, or seed data.

item.name: ❌ PUT opening balance — non-leaf (parent) account → 400
item.description:
❌ Expected: **400 Bad Request**.

**Rule V1 / O1:** Opening balance can only be set on **leaf** accounts.

Message: `Opening balance can only be set on leaf accounts.`

Default `validationParentNonLeaf` = **1** (root الأصول, `isLeaf=false`).

item.name: ❌ PUT opening balance — account has transaction lines → 400
item.description:
❌ Expected: **400 Bad Request** (if account is non-system, leaf, unlocked, but **already has lines**) OR **403** if system account.

**Rule O2/O3:** Message: `Opening balance cannot be changed while the account has transaction lines.`

Set `leafAccountWithJournalLines` to a **non-system** leaf that already appears on at least one transaction line (default **55** — adjust if your seed differs).

item.name: ❌ PUT opening balance — current OB not zero → 400
item.description:
❌ Expected: **400 Bad Request** when stored `openingBalance` ≠ 0 (and not locked from create).

Message: `Opening balance can only be set when the current opening balance is zero.`

Set `accountWithNonZeroOpening` to a suitable test id, or create a leaf with `openingBalance` via POST (locked) then call PUT again.

item.name: ℹ️ POST transaction — saves → locks OB on line accounts (O3/T4)
item.description:
✅ Expected: **201 Created**.

**After save:** backend sets `openingBalanceLocked=true` on both line accounts (rules **O3/T4**). Re-run **PUT** opening-balance on those ids → **400** already locked / or lines exist.

Defaults: `validationDebitAccountId` / `validationCreditAccountId` — use two distinct **leaf** ids (e.g. **55** and **18** if allowed). Adjust if your chart differs.

item.name: ❌ Line amount < 0.01 (DTO) → 400
item.description:
❌ Expected: **400 Bad Request** (class-validator).

**Rule T2:** `CreateTransactionLineDTO.amount` must be **≥ 0.01**.

Message pattern: `Amount must be greater than zero`.

(Using `0` also breaks balance; use **0.005** to isolate Min validation if your client sends it.)

item.name: 💳 Transactions
item.description:
Journal entry management.

**Business rules**
- Minimum 2 lines per transaction.
- Each account may appear **at most once** across all lines.
- **Debits must equal Credits** (balanced equation). Checked at save/update.
- `POSTED` and `CANCELLED` transactions **cannot be modified**.
- Only `isLeaf=true` accounts can be used on lines.
- Each line `amount` must be **≥ 0.01** (class-validator `Min`).
- After save, line accounts get `openingBalanceLocked=true` (see **🔒 Validation** folder).
- `status` can be `DRAFT` (editable) or `POSTED` (final/immutable) or `CANCELLED`.

**See also:** **🔒 Validation — server rules (accounting)** → `❌ Line amount < 0.01`.

item.name: List POSTED transactions
item.description: Filter by `status`. Useful for reports (which only include POSTED entries).

item.name: Get transaction by ID
item.description: Returns the transaction with its `transactionLines` and each line's `account` details.

item.name: ✅ Create DRAFT transaction
item.description: Creates a balanced two-line DRAFT entry. DRAFT entries appear in the transaction list but are **excluded from all financial reports** (reports only include POSTED entries). Saves id → `{{newTxId}}`.

item.name: ✅ Create POSTED transaction (multi-line)
item.description: Multi-line POSTED entry (split between two debit accounts and two credit accounts). Debits = 40,000, Credits = 40,000 ✅. POSTED entries are immediately included in all financial reports.

item.name: ✅ Update DRAFT transaction
item.description: Promotes a DRAFT to POSTED (or updates any field). Once POSTED this entry is **permanently immutable**.

item.name: ❌ Update POSTED transaction → 400
item.description:
❌ Expected: **400 Bad Request**.

Rule: POSTED transactions are final. The service checks the **persisted** status (not the incoming body) so the guard cannot be bypassed.

item.name: ❌ Unbalanced transaction (DR ≠ CR) → 400
item.description:
❌ Expected: **400 Bad Request**.

Rule: Total debits (10,000) ≠ total credits (7,000). Difference > 0.01 triggers the balance check.

item.name: ❌ Only 1 line → 400
item.description:
❌ Expected: **400 Bad Request**.

Rule: Every transaction must have at least **2 lines** (the double-entry requirement).

item.name: ❌ Duplicate account in lines → 400
item.description:
❌ Expected: **400 Bad Request**.

Rule: Each account may appear **only once** across all lines of the same transaction. Debiting and crediting the same account in a single entry is not allowed.

item.name: ❌ Non-leaf account in line → 400
item.description:
❌ Expected: **400 Bad Request**.

Rule: Account id=1 (الأصول) is a **parent/header** node (`isLeaf=false`). Only leaf accounts (no sub-accounts) accept journal lines. Parent balances are always computed as roll-ups from leaves in the reports.

item.name: ❌ Transaction not found → 404
item.description: ❌ Expected: **404 Not Found**.

item.name: ✅ Delete transaction
item.description: Deletes a transaction and its lines (CASCADE). Any status can be deleted from the API (no guard on delete) — the guard only blocks **edits** of POSTED/CANCELLED.

item.name: 📝 Transaction Lines
item.description:
Individual debit/credit line management.

Normally lines are created embedded inside a transaction (POST `/transactions`). These endpoints allow direct CRUD on individual lines, e.g. to add/fix a line on an existing DRAFT transaction.

item.name: ✅ Create transaction line
item.description: Creates a single transaction line. Note: this endpoint does **not** validate the overall transaction balance — use the transaction-level POST to ensure balance is enforced at creation.

item.name: ✅ Update transaction line
item.description: Partial update — only the sent fields are changed. All fields are optional.

item.name: 📊 Financial Reports
item.description:
Read-only financial reports. All reports only aggregate **POSTED** transactions.

| Report | Pagination | Key query params |
|---|---|---|
| General Ledger | Yes (page/pageSize) | accountId, dateFrom, dateTo |
| Trial Balance | No | dateFrom, dateTo, flat |
| Income Statement | No | dateFrom, dateTo, flat |
| Balance Sheet | No | asOf, flat, comparePriorYear |

**`flat` flag**: `flat=true` → simple arrays; `flat=false` (default) → nested tree with rolled-up parent totals.

item.name: 📒 General Ledger
item.description: Account-level activity: opening balance, line-by-line entries with running balance, and closing balance for a period.

item.name: Ledger — Cash (full period)
item.description:
Returns:
- `openingBalance`: stored opening + POSTED activity strictly **before** dateFrom.
- `lines[]`: each line has `date`, `transactionCode`, `description`, `debit`, `credit`, `balance` (running).
- `periodTotalDebits` / `periodTotalCredits`: full-period totals (not page-limited).
- `periodClosingBalance`: net balance at end of full period.
- Pagination headers: `X-Total-Count`, `Current-Page`, `Has-Next-Page`.

item.name: Ledger — no dateFrom (opening = stored only)
item.description: When `dateFrom` is omitted, `openingBalance` = stored account opening balance only (no prior-period postings added). All POSTED lines up to `dateTo` appear in `lines[]`.

item.name: Ledger — paginated (page 2)
item.description: `periodTotalDebits`, `periodTotalCredits`, and `periodClosingBalance` always reflect the **full period** regardless of the current page. Only `lines[]` and `closingBalance` change per page.

item.name: ⚖️ Trial Balance
item.description: Per-account debit/credit summary. Includes opening balance (stored + pre-period activity) and closing balance. `grandTotalDebit` = `grandTotalCredit` when `isBalanced=true`.

item.name: Trial Balance — flat (default period)
item.description:
Returns `lines[]` (flat list). Each line has:
- `accountId`, `accountCode`, `accountName`, `accountType`, `normalBalance`
- `totalDebit` / `totalCredit`: period movements
- `balance`: net period movement (signed)
- `openingBalance` / `openingDebit` / `openingCredit`: start-of-period
- `closingBalance` / `closingDebit` / `closingCredit`: end-of-period

`grandTotalDebit` = `grandTotalCredit` when `isBalanced=true` ✅

item.name: Trial Balance — tree (nested, flat=false)
item.description: Returns `tree[]` — each root node contains `children[]` recursively. Parent node totals are **rolled up** from their descendants (parent total = own value + sum of children). Useful for tree-view displays.

item.name: Trial Balance — no date filter (all time)
item.description: Omitting both `dateFrom` and `dateTo` aggregates all POSTED transactions from the beginning of time. `openingBalance` will be the stored account opening balance (no prior-period activity exists).

item.name: 📈 Income Statement
item.description: Profit & Loss for a period. `netIncome = totalRevenue − totalExpenses`. Only POSTED transactions are included.

item.name: Income Statement — flat (P&L lines)
item.description:
Returns `revenues[]` and `expenses[]` (flat lists) + `totalRevenue`, `totalExpenses`, `netIncome`.

For REVENUE: `amount` = credits − debits (net revenue).
For EXPENSE: `amount` = debits − credits (net cost).
`netIncome` = totalRevenue − totalExpenses.

item.name: Income Statement — tree (grouped by category)
item.description: Returns `revenueTree[]` and `expenseTree[]`. Each tree node's `amount` = own leaf posting + sum of children (rolled up). Root node of each tree represents the total for that category.

item.name: Income Statement — Q1 2026
item.description:
Expected from our demo data:
- Total Revenue: 225,000 (150K cash + 75K credit)
- Total Expenses: 95,000 (60K purchases + 25K ops + 10K general)
- Net Income: **130,000** ✅

item.name: 🏦 Balance Sheet
item.description:
Point-in-time snapshot of Assets = Liabilities + Equity.

Balances include:
- Each account's stored `openingBalance`
- Plus cumulative POSTED activity up to `asOf`

The synthetic `NET-INCOME` line (accountId=0, accountCode='NET-INCOME') is auto-injected into equity when `netIncome ≠ 0`. This represents current-year unrealised P&L not yet closed to retained earnings.

`isBalanced=true` means `|Assets − (Liabilities + Equity)| < 0.01`.

item.name: Balance Sheet — flat, as of today
item.description: Omitting `asOf` defaults to today. Returns `assets[]`, `liabilities[]`, `equity[]` + totals + `isBalanced`.

item.name: Balance Sheet — flat, as of 2026-03-31
item.description:
Expected from demo data (Q1 2026):
- Total Assets: **780,000** (Cash 135K + Bank 490K + Receivables 75K + Machinery 80K)
- Total Liabilities: **150,000** (Suppliers 50K + Loans 100K)
- Total Equity: **630,000** (Capital 500K + NET-INCOME 130K)
- isBalanced: **true** ✅ (780,000 = 150,000 + 630,000)

item.name: Balance Sheet — tree (nested hierarchy)
item.description: Returns `assetTree[]`, `liabilityTree[]`, `equityTree[]`. Each tree node has `children[]` with its sub-accounts. Parent `balance` = own balance + sum of children (rolled up). Synthetic NET-INCOME node is appended to equityTree.

item.name: Balance Sheet — with prior year comparison
item.description:
Adds `balancePriorYear` to each account line and populates:
- `asOfPriorYear`: the same calendar date one year earlier (2025-03-31)
- `totalAssetsPriorYear`, `totalLiabilitiesPriorYear`, `totalEquityPriorYear`
- `isBalancedPriorYear`
